open_questions: For pg13to16_postmaster_symlinks_removed: The documentation does not specify whether existing symlinks will be removed during upgrade or simply not created for new installations. Need to verify upgrade behavior.
For pg13to16_plpgsql_cursor_assignment_changed: Unclear how common it is for applications to depend on cursor variable string values matching variable names. This may be a rare edge case.
For pg13to16_reindex_database_system_catalogs: Unclear how many applications intentionally reindex system catalogs via REINDEX DATABASE. May be a low-impact change for most users.

For pg13to16_generated_column_inheritance: The behavior when existing schemas violate the new requirements is not fully specified - whether pg_upgrade will fail, pg_restore will fail, or the system will accept the data with warnings.
For pg13to16_role_inheritance_grant_behavior: Migration behavior for existing role memberships during pg_upgrade is not fully detailed in the provided documentation.
